_doc: The aluminium of item's profiles, for analysis. item names no single alloy: "AlMgSi alloys of the EN-AW-6000-series are used", chosen by application and availability, extruded to DIN EN 12020. Strengths, moduli and density are item's own technical data, which apply in the pressing direction only. item gives no Poisson's ratio.
name: al6000-item

poisson.rule: Poisson's ratio: item gives none, and its two rounded moduli (ca. 70,000 and ca. 25,000) come to 0.4, which no aluminium has. Hydro's sheets for 6060 and 6063 come to 0.33; that is used
poisson.source: al6063-t5 rule set (Hydro, Alloy EN AW-6063, Rev.4 03/2023); not from item

strength.rule: Yield point Rp0,2, "min. 195" N/mm² (in the pressing direction)

ultimate.rule: Tensile strength Rm, "min. 245" N/mm² (in the pressing direction)
